title: Chordal graphs: minimal separators and simplicial vertices
abstract: A reusable formalization byproduct accompanying Paper II: defines chordal graphs through the cycle-and-chord characterization, proves induced-subgraph heredity and the clique property for finite minimal separators of fixed vertex pairs, proves Dirac's simplicial-vertex theorem, and proves the connected non-complete case of the two-vertex conclusion.

informal.SimpleGraph.IsChordal.comap: A graph that embeds as an induced subgraph of a chordal graph is itself chordal.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsChordal.induce: Every induced subgraph of a chordal graph is chordal.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsChordal.minimalSeparator_i: Every finite minimal separator of two fixed vertices in a chordal graph is a clique.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsChordal.exists_isSimplicia: Every nonempty finite chordal graph has a simplicial vertex.
informal.SimpleGraph.IsChordal.exists_two_nonadj_: Every connected non-complete finite chordal graph has two non-adjacent simplicial vertices.
